project: Weather Forecasting and Avatar Styling App

test_cases.title: Log in with the correct code
steps: Enter student@example.test on the login screen and submit the form.
Enter 1234 on the code screen and click Log in.
test_cases.expected: The home.html screen opens, and no screen asks for a password.

test_cases.title: A wrong code is refused
steps: Enter 1111 in the verification code field.
test_cases.expected: The message 'Incorrect code. Please try again.' appears, and the user remains on the code screen.

test_cases.title: An empty email field is refused
steps: Click the button to submit the email form.
test_cases.expected: The browser prevents submission and indicates that the required email field must be filled in.

test_cases.title: View today's and tomorrow's Istanbul forecast
test_cases.expected: The weather screen shows today's temperature as 22°C and sunny with a 10% chance of rain, and tomorrow's temperature as 18°C and rainy with a 70% chance of rain.

test_cases.title: No matching location is found
steps: Enter Paris in the location search field.
test_cases.expected: The message 'No matching locations found.' appears, and Paris is not selected as a supported location.

test_cases.title: Get recommendations for cooler and rainy weather
test_cases.precondition: The outfit suggestions screen is open.
test_cases.expected: The screen recommends clothing suitable for cooler weather and advises bringing an umbrella and wearing water-resistant footwear for tomorrow's heavy rain.

test_cases.title: Outfit suggestions error state when weather data is missing
test_cases.precondition: An unsupported location with missing weather data is selected.
steps: Navigate to the outfit suggestions screen.
test_cases.expected: The screen displays an error message 'Outfit recommendations unavailable for this location' rather than broken text.

test_cases.title: Customize the avatar's appearance
test_cases.expected: The avatar preview updates to reflect the selected hair, makeup, and clothing options.

test_cases.title: Change avatar type and body size
test_cases.expected: The avatar preview updates to reflect the selected avatar type and body size.

test_cases.title: Every screen fits a phone 390 px wide
test_cases.precondition: The browser's phone view is set to 390 px wide.
steps: Visit code.html, home.html, location.html, outfits.html, avatar.html, and alert.html using the available links.
test_cases.expected: Every screen has no horizontal scrollbar, no cut-off text, and all buttons and controls are reachable.

test_cases.title: Show a severe weather alert
test_cases.precondition: Ankara is selected and the weather dashboard is open.
test_cases.expected: The dashboard displays an alert that heavy rain is expected tomorrow and provides a recommended safety action.

test_cases.title: Alert details fail to load
test_cases.precondition: The severe weather alert banner is clicked.
steps: Open alert.html when alert services are unavailable.
test_cases.expected: The page displays an error message 'Unable to retrieve alert details at this time.'

test_cases.title: Display the forecast and recommendations within three seconds
test_cases.precondition: The prototype is open in the browser.
steps: Measure the time until the forecast and recommendations are visible.
test_cases.expected: The forecast and recommendations are visible within three seconds.

test_cases.title: Check readable text and clear controls
test_cases.precondition: The prototype is open at a 390 px viewport width.
steps: Check whether important text is readable.
Check whether the purpose of each main button and control is clear.
test_cases.expected: Important text is readable, controls are distinguishable, and the purpose of each main action is clear.
